artworks.title: Une 1er reprèsentation de la bourse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of seated and standing individuals in a theater audience. The image shows the backs of these audience members, who appear to be focused intently on the stage. The drawing is in black and white, using shaded pencil or charcoal lines to create depth and texture within the scene. The view is from behind the seats, giving the impression of being part of the audience. The foreground and background are separated effectively, with distinct lines marking rows of spectators. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century illustrations, with a focus on capturing the social behavior and atmosphere typical of that era's theater culture.

artworks.title: La tête de Méduse pour l'épicier fautif
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring three characters in a shop scene with various objects. The illustration depicts a man behind a counter on the left, facing two other figures in front of him. One figure is leaning over a balance scale on the counter. Shelves holding bottles and large jars are visible in the background. The setting implies a shop or apothecary environment filled with everyday items, potentially showing a moment of exchange or transaction. The drawing showcases strong lines and shading, capturing the characters' reactions and providing a detailed look into 19th-century commercial life.

artworks.title: Ayant eu ... l'idée d'aller ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated in armchairs facing each other. The person on the left is positioned in profile, with arms crossed, leaning slightly back in their chair. They have their hair pulled back into a bun and are wearing a long dress with sleeves. The person on the right also sits in profile and leans back, with hands resting on their lap. This person has short, curly hair and is dressed in a buttoned jacket and pants. Both figures are depicted in a shaded, sketch-like style. The background features a large window behind them, framed by curtains, through which a scenic landscape is visible, suggesting an outdoor view with stormy weather as indicated by the heavy winds and rain depicted in the sketch.

artworks.title: Voici votre comptre: Il vous revenait ...

artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two men standing in front of a plain background. The first man, with long hair and dressed in a long coat and checkered stockings, is leaning on a surface. The second man, wearing a long coat over a shirt and loose-fitting pants, is gesturing as if speaking. Text is included below the image.

artworks.title: Monsieur, Auriez-vous la bonté de me dire ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: Two men are shown in a pool environment. The man on the left has a muscular build, short, curly hair, and sideburns. He wears striped swimming trunks and stands confidently with his hands on his hips. The man on the right tips his hat towards the other man. He has short hair, a mustache, and wears a suit with a tie, trousers, and dress shoes, holding a coat or blanket. The background shows people swimming and others standing or walking around the pool. Text is included in the upper section of the image.

artworks.title: Cinq coeurs, quinte et quatorze ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with three figures appearing to engage in conversation or playing cards. The focus is on a table where three figures are gathered. Two are seated while one leans on the table. The seated figures seem to be older individuals with scattered papers and cards on the table. A bottle and glasses suggest a social setting. The interior features high, shadowy walls with architectural details such as columns and paneling. The use of shading highlights the expressions and gestures of the figures, giving a sense of curiosity or debate. The style of the drawing emphasizes expressive and exaggerated features.

artworks.title: Ils vont un train d'enfer ...

artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman walking side by side. The man on the left wears a tall hat, long coat, and holds a cane. The woman on the right wears a bonnet and a long dress, and carries a woven basket. The background shows a barren landscape with a distant train emitting smoke.

artworks.title: En contemplation devant le vaisseau de l'opera
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people standing closely together on a balcony. The central figure is an older man with a bald head, glasses, and a serious expression. He is wearing a dark suit or jacket over a light shirt and has his hands clasped over his stomach. To his left is a woman with her hair styled back, wearing a dress with puffed sleeves and looking attentive. Other individuals around them have diverse features and hairstyles. They are all positioned closely together and are peering over the balcony railing. The background shows a faint sketch of a textured wall, and the title "Croquis Parisiens" is visible above the drawing.

artworks.title: En contemplation devant le vaisseau de l'opera
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals seated in a box at a theater or opera. They are focused on the stage, with various expressions. The central figure is a bald man with glasses and a striped suit jacket. He is flanked by a woman with curly hair and a patterned dress on the right, and another person resting their head on their arms on the left. The background features a curtained wall.

artworks.title: Vue prise a Argenteuil (Octobre 1856)

artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals working in a field or vineyard. They are shown from the waist down, bent over while picking crops or gardening. One person is standing upright and visible from the side, wearing a flat cap. They have various hairstyles, covered with headscarves or hats, and are dressed in long-sleeve shirts and knee-length skirts or dresses. Baskets filled with harvested produce, likely grapes, are scattered around. The background shows a rural landscape with plants arranged in rows.

One figure points outwards while the other figure looks on. The city features buildings and a hill with a windmill. There is text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Votre maison me fait l'effet de devoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted in a full-body view. They are standing close to each other, engaged in conversation. Both men have prominent facial features with angular noses and chins, and they are wearing top hats. Their hair is partially visible beneath the hats. The man on the left is wearing a suit with a waistcoat, while the man on the right is wearing a long coat over a suit. They are both well-dressed. The man on the right is holding a small object. In the background, there is an unfinished building with scaffolding, where a worker is climbing a ladder holding a board on his shoulder.

artworks.title: Un entr'acte, par trente degrés de chaleur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing side by side. The man on the left has wide eyes and an open mouth, while the man on the right has one hand to his forehead and appears to be looking down. Both men have short, dark hair and are dressed in similar outfits. They are each holding a top hat. Surrounding them is a crowd of people in similar attire. In the background, there is a building or wall with writing and a window with a pattern. The setting suggests an urban environment.

artworks.title: Tent deux degrés!!!

artworks.description: The image shows two people reclining in a room. A woman with curly hair and a man with short hair are seated on wooden chairs. A dog lies on the floor between them. A door with detailed framing leads to a balcony. The background is a simple interior wall with framed details. The style is charcoal or pencil sketch with shading for depth. The image includes the text "Trente deux degrés."

artworks.title: Les bains a quatre sous
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded indoor environment with various activities occurring. The artwork depicts numerous individuals in an enclosed space. In the foreground, figures emerge from water surrounded by nets. Above them, a walkway extends with individuals engaging in acrobatics. On the sides and in the background, onlookers observe. The drawing conveys movement and a sense of mass gathering through bold lines and a dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Pour s'habiteur a attendre le lion ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man facing a mounted lion on wheels. The man is drawn in formal attire with a top hat and monocle, holding a stick while looking at the lion. The lion is stationary on the wheeled platform. The drawing has exaggerated features on both characters with fine lines and shading for texture. The lion's expression is exaggerated and cartoon-like. The title is "Émotions de Chasse."

artworks.title: Ce perdreau est mort sur mon terrain ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with two figures and a dog among cabbages. The image depicts a rustic setting where the figures are in the midst of a conversation. One figure holds a rifle and looks towards the other figure who is holding a dead bird and gesturing with a hand raised to his mouth. In the background, cabbages are strewn across the ground. The drawing has a humorous tone.

artworks.title: Mossieu la directeur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a man and a woman standing side by side. The man stands to the right with an upright posture, while the woman is on the left leaning slightly towards him. The man has short, possibly curly hair, sharp facial features, and is dressed in a dark suit with a bow tie. The woman has curly hair, a youthful face, and is wearing a light-colored dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt. In the background, there are two faintly sketched figures with a textured gradient backdrop resembling a theater setting.

artworks.title: Agamemnon se fiasant couronner a huis-clos
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a room. One man is sitting in a chair with his legs crossed and looking at his reflection in a mirror, while the other man stands behind him, placing a crown on his head. The seated man's reflection in the mirror shows elongated facial features, dark long hair, and he is wearing a robe. The standing man has curly hair and a focused expression, wearing a long-sleeved shirt and trousers. A coat or fabric hangs on the wall behind him, and there is a lit candle sconce on the wall.

artworks.title: Le mère d ela chanteuse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene. The illustration depicts a stage viewed from behind a curtain, where a figure in a long gown stands. In the background, an audience can be seen, with their faces denoted by simple lines. Near the edge of the stage, three individuals seem to be observers behind the scenes. One appears to be leaning forward with a hand to their face. This drawing captures the contrast between the bright stage and the shadowed backstage, evoking the spirit of theatrical performances.

artworks.title: Dire que dans mon temps, moi aussi ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dancer and an onlooker. The dancer is depicted in expressive movement, with their dress swirling around them. The onlooker is seated opposite the dancer, observing intently. The background suggests a stage setting. The style of the drawing uses sharp contrasts and flowing lines.

artworks.title: Une expèrience culinaire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of three adults and the partial figure of a child sitting around a dining table. The person on the left is seen in profile, sitting upright with a slightly hunched posture, pointed facial features, a scruffy hairstyle, and an expression that appears dissatisfied. This person is dressed in a long-sleeved garment. In the center is another adult with a bald head, slightly leaning forward with a serious expression, as they are actively engaged in cutting food on a plate. This person is also wearing a long-sleeved top. Next to them on the right is a woman whose back is visible, with her hair styled in a bun and she's leaning slightly forward. Across from her, mostly obscured, is a child with their head bowed down towards the table. The table is set with eating utensils, plates, a glass, and a bottle, suggesting a dining scene. In the background, there are framed pictures on the wall, indicating the setting is indoors, likely in a dining area or a restaurant.
